run_callback_modification_check: run a static analysis check on a Python file to detect direct litellm callback list modifications
scan_directory_for_callback_violations: scan a directory tree of Python files for unauthorized litellm callback list modifications
test_no_unauthorized_callback_modificati: test the entire litellm codebase to ensure no direct callback list modifications exist
review_check_for_callback_modifications: review the AST-based callback modification detection logic to understand which operations are forbidden
refactor_allowed_files_list: refactor the ALLOWED_FILES list to add or remove exempted callback manager file paths
